email_text: Where can I download my invoice for last month?
expected_summary: User is requesting a copy of last month's invoice.

email_text: Your app crashes every time I try to cancel my premium plan! Stop charging me!
expected_summary: User wants to cancel their premium plan but is blocked by app crashes.
notes: Mentions crashes, but primary intent is cancellation/money.

email_text: Your app crashes every time I try to cancel my pro plan! You  guys can't stop charging me enough :(
expected_summary: User wants to cancel their premium plan but is blocked by app crashes.
notes: Mentions crashes, but primary intent is cancellation/money. User is being sarcastic when they say 'You guys can't stop charging me enough'.

email_text: I was charged twice this month for my subscription.
expected_summary: User reports a double charge for their subscription.

email_text: My company is tax-exempt. How do I remove VAT from my upcoming renewal?
expected_summary: User is asking how to apply tax exemption to their renewal.
notes: Tax-related, requires model to map VAT/tax to billing.

email_text: The payment portal says 'Card Declined' but my bank says it was approved.
expected_summary: User's card is being declined despite bank approval.

email_text: Can I pay for the enterprise tier using a wire transfer instead of a credit card?
expected_summary: User is asking if wire transfers are accepted for enterprise payments.

email_text: I upgraded to Pro yesterday, but my limits haven't increased and my card was billed.
expected_summary: User paid for an upgrade but the features have not activated.
notes: Crosses into account limits, but root issue is fulfillment of a billed transaction.

email_text: What is this $49 charge on my statement from 'STRIPE*STORE'?
expected_summary: User is questioning an unrecognized charge on their statement.

email_text: I want to dispute a charge, but I literally can't even log into my account.
expected_summary: User wants to dispute a charge but is locked out of their account.
notes: Account access vs billing dispute. Priority is resolving the money issue.

email_text: Do you offer prorated refunds if I downgrade mid-month?
expected_summary: User is inquiring about prorated refunds for downgrading.

email_text: My accountant needs a W-9 form from you before we can process this month's software invoice.
expected_summary: User is requesting a W-9 form for accounting purposes.

email_text: Please update the billing address on file to our new HQ.
expected_summary: User wants to update their billing address.

email_text: I got an email saying my payment failed, but I didn't get a link to fix it.
expected_summary: User received a failed payment notice without an update link.

email_text: The CSV export tool is throwing a timeout error on large files.
expected_summary: User reports a timeout error when using the CSV export tool.

email_text: I lost my 2FA phone and can't bypass the security prompt. The code isn't sending to my backup email.
expected_summary: User is locked out due to failing backup email for 2FA.
notes: Account access issue, fundamentally caused by a technical failure.

email_text: Your API is returning a 429 Too Many Requests even though I am well below my rate limit.
expected_summary: User is falsely receiving 429 API rate limit errors.

email_text: The mobile app is completely unresponsive on iOS 17 beta.
expected_summary: User reports the mobile app freezes on iOS 17 beta.

email_text: I can't add my credit card. The 'Submit' button is grayed out on Chrome but works on Safari.
expected_summary: User cannot submit payment info due to a disabled button in Chrome.
notes: Involves credit card, but it's a browser-specific UI bug.

email_text: My webhook integration stopped receiving events at 3:00 AM PST.
expected_summary: User's webhook integration stopped working at a specific time.

email_text: Whenever I try to upload my avatar, it says 'File too large' even though it's only 1MB.
expected_summary: User is getting false file size errors when uploading an avatar.

email_text: Is the system down? My whole team is just getting a blank white screen.
expected_summary: User is reporting a team-wide blank screen outage.

email_text: I'm trying to delete my account but the confirmation email never arrives.
expected_summary: User is not receiving the account deletion confirmation email.
notes: Account deletion intent, but blocked by a technical email delivery failure.

email_text: The dashboard is taking over 30 seconds to load the analytics widgets.
expected_summary: User is experiencing extreme latency on the analytics dashboard.

email_text: Dark mode is broken; half the text is still black and impossible to read.
expected_summary: User reports unreadable text due to a broken dark mode.

email_text: Our SSO via Okta is failing with an 'Invalid SAML token' error.
expected_summary: User is experiencing an Okta SSO failure with an invalid token error.

email_text: I clicked 'Upgrade Plan' but it just redirected me to a 404 page.
expected_summary: User is hitting a 404 error when trying to upgrade their plan.
notes: Billing intent blocked by a dead link.

email_text: How do I change the primary owner of this workspace?
expected_summary: User wants to transfer workspace ownership.

email_text: Under GDPR, I request all my data be permanently deleted from your servers.
expected_summary: User is submitting a GDPR data deletion request.
notes: Legal/compliance aspect, but functionally an account deletion task.

email_text: I need to change my login email from my old company address to my new one.
expected_summary: User wants to update their login email address.

email_text: Can I merge two different accounts together without losing my data?
expected_summary: User is asking if they can merge two accounts.

email_text: I forgot my password and I don't have access to the recovery email anymore.
expected_summary: User forgot password and lost access to recovery email.
notes: Could look technical, but it's a standard account recovery flow.

email_text: How do I add my coworker to my team so they can see my projects?
expected_summary: User wants to invite a coworker to their team.

email_text: Please suspend my account temporarily while I am on maternity leave.
expected_summary: User is requesting a temporary account suspension.

email_text: Why was my account banned? I didn't violate the terms of service!
expected_summary: User is appealing an account ban.

email_text: I want to downgrade to the free tier, but I want to make sure I don't lose my saved templates.
expected_summary: User wants to downgrade to free without losing saved templates.
notes: Mentions downgrade (billing), but the core question is about account data retention.

email_text: How do I set up a secondary admin for my organization?
expected_summary: User is asking how to assign a secondary admin role.

email_text: I need to update my display name, it's spelling my name wrong.
expected_summary: User wants to correct the spelling of their display name.

email_text: Can I enforce mandatory 2FA for everyone in my company workspace?
expected_summary: User wants to know if they can enforce 2FA for their entire workspace.
notes: Security setting, but applied at the workspace/account management level.

email_text: Do you offer discounts for non-profits?
expected_summary: User is inquiring about non-profit discounts.

email_text: I love the new update! Are you planning to add a dark mode soon?
expected_summary: User is providing positive feedback and asking about a dark mode feature.
notes: Feature request/feedback; shouldn't confuse 'update' with a technical bug.

email_text: What are your standard support hours?
expected_summary: User is asking about customer support operating hours.

email_text: We are a large agency and want to discuss an enterprise partnership. Who can we talk to?
expected_summary: User is an agency seeking an enterprise partnership conversation.

email_text: Do you have any case studies on how marketing teams use your product?
expected_summary: User is requesting case studies for marketing teams.

email_text: Where is your company headquartered?
expected_summary: User is asking for the company's headquarters location.

email_text: Your competitor just released an AI feature, will you guys do the same?
expected_summary: User is asking if an AI feature will be added to match a competitor.

email_text: Is there a link to your API documentation? I can't find it in the footer.
expected_summary: User is looking for a link to the API documentation.
notes: Mentions API, but it's a navigational/documentation question, not a bug.

email_text: I really hated the recent UI changes. Please change it back.
expected_summary: User is expressing dissatisfaction with recent UI changes.

email_text: Are you guys hiring product managers? I'd love to apply.
expected_summary: User is asking about open product manager roles.

email_text: Can I get a custom SLA if I sign an annual contract?
expected_summary: User is asking about custom SLAs for annual contracts.
notes: Sales/legal inquiry that touches on billing concepts.

email_text: Just wanted to say your support agent David was amazing today. Give him a raise!
expected_summary: User is leaving positive feedback for a support agent named David.
